Skeledirge +2 SpA, Unaware, LumBerry, Fire-immune to burn, resists Flare Blitz, Torch Song self-boosts. Corviknight 35% with Mirror Armor (never Parting Shot/Wisp it). Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag) and Klefki (Prankster screens/TWave) still in box. Only Incineroar + Farigiraf remain (Sneasler, Skarmory fainted). Win condition: Farigiraf Trick Room flipping speed for my slow mons, then Incineroar Flare Blitz cleans Corviknight. Preserve Farigiraf as setter; keep Incineroar as Intimidate pivot. Burn Gyarados to remove physical pressure. Skeledirge is hard to break (Ghost immune to Body Press/Hyper Voice, resists Flare Blitz) - must outlast/wear it down; it is the main threat.

decisions.rationale: Gyarados Taunt on Farigiraf (guaranteed first via 130 Spe vs 80-112) shuts down Trick Room AND weakened Protect. Skeledirge Torch Song chips 53-120% of Farigiraf HP (at 67%) for likely KO or heavy damage plus SpA+3. If Farigiraf survives, it's Taunted and can't TR next turn—clean finish. Incineroar's threats are minimal: Flare Blitz NVE on both, WoW cured by Lum on Skeledirge, Parting Shot can't pivot with no bench.
decisions.notebook: G3 T10: Taunt+Torch Song into Farigiraf. Taunt prevents TR (Gyarados 130 > Farigiraf 80-112) and Protect. Torch Song 53-120% on Farigiraf at 67%—likely KO or heavy chip. If Farigiraf survives, it's Taunted 3 more turns, can't TR. Next turn: finish Farigiraf with Torch Song/Crunch, then 3v1 vs Incineroar (Waterfall 2x SE). Skeledirge Lum Berry intact. Watch Parting Shot dropping Skeledirge SpA—still boosted enough to finish. Corviknight 35% emergency only.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Incineroar)

Trick Room is essential to flip speed so my slow pair acts first. Setting it now (Skeledirge at +2, Torch Song 48-101%) gives Farigiraf its best survival chance vs waiting (at +3 it's 60-108%, near-certain OHKO before the -7 TR resolves). Incineroar chips Skeledirge with Flare Blitz to set up a Psychic+Flare Blitz KO under TR.
decisions.notebook: Durable: Skeledirge is the main threat (+2 SpA, Unaware, LumBerry cures status not HP, Fire-immune to burn, resists Flare Blitz, Ghost-immune to Normal/Hyper Voice). Gyarados brn, -1 Atk, holds Taunt (can block Trick Room). Corviknight 35% benched, Mirror Armor (never Parting Shot/Wisp it). Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag) and Klefki (Prankster screens/TWave) not brought. Only Incineroar + Farigiraf remain; Sneasler, Skarmory fainted. Win condition: get Trick Room up, then double Skeledirge (Farigiraf Psychic + Incineroar Flare Blitz) before it out-boosts; Flare Blitz cleans Corviknight. Trick Room is priority -7 so Farigiraf always sets it last and is vulnerable to Skeledirge's Torch Song that same turn.

decisions.rationale: 3v1 endgame vs lone Incineroar at 83%. Waterfall (2x SE, 18-32%) + Torch Song (35-64% at +3 SpA) combine for 53-96%, likely KO or heavy chip. Torch Song boosts to +4 SpA, guaranteeing next-turn KO if needed. Incineroar's Flare Blitz is 0.5x into both my mons; Will-O-Wisp cured by Lum on Skeledirge and Gyarados already burned. Parting Shot fails with no remaining switches. No need to Protect or Taunt—just maximize damage and close it out.
decisions.notebook: G3 T11: 3v1 endgame vs lone Incineroar at 83%. Waterfall+Torch Song should KO or leave it near death; +4 SpA next turn guarantees finish. Skeledirge Lum Berry still intact. Corviknight 35% emergency only. Series tied 1-1, this game essentially won.

decisions.rationale: Down to Incineroar alone (Farigiraf fainted; Parting Shot has no switch target and fails). Both foes outspeed and their combined Torch Song+Waterfall likely KO Incineroar this turn. Neither Flare Blitz KOs (Skeledirge 15-35%, Gyarados 19-44%), so target the main threat: Flare Blitz Skeledirge to pressure the +3 SpA Unaware win condition before falling.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar at 18% is the last foe standing. Gyarados (130 Spe) outspeeds Incineroar (80-112) and Waterfall does 16-36%—possible non-KO. Skeledirge Torch Song at +4 SpA does 38-84%, guaranteed KO from 18%. Either hit finishes; both targeting Incineroar seals the game. Incineroar has no Protect and Parting Shot has no switch target.

Sneasler FocusSash Unburden Jolly 154-189 Spe. Farigiraf Modest 80-112 Spe ArmorTail Sitrus. Skarmory Impish 90-122 Sturdy Occa Berry. decisions.rationale: Incineroar is the last remaining Pokémon at 18% HP and is outsped by both foes. Skeledirge's +4 Torch Song alone deals 33-59% of max HP, KOing Incineroar before it can act. With Farigiraf fainted and no other Pokémon, the game is unwinnable; forfeiting is correct.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Skeledirge is the primary threat—Unaware ignores boosts, Fire-immune to burn, resists Flare Blitz, Ghost-immune to Normal/Hyper Voice; it out-boosts via Torch Song and must be doubled (Psychic+Flare Blitz) before it snowballs. Gyarados brn/-1 Atk holds Taunt (blocks Trick Room). Corviknight Mirror Armor: never Parting Shot/Wisp it. Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag) and Klefki (Prankster screens/TWave) not brought. Flare Blitz does not OHKO Skeledirge (~15-35%) or Gyarados (~19-44%). Trick Room win condition requires Farigiraf alive; Parting Shot is dead weight when Incineroar is the last mon. reflections.summary: Game 3 and the series were won because Skeledirge's Torch Song snowballed out of control (+4 SpA by endgame) while Gyarados Taunt repeatedly denied Farigiraf's Trick Room, neutralizing the opponent's speed-control win condition. The four brought (Skeledirge, Gyarados, Mamoswine, Corviknight) were well-chosen: Skeledirge's Unaware + Torch Song punished the opponent's setup-oriented team, Gyarados handled Farigiraf and provided Intimidate support, and Mamoswine offered priority and speed control. Zero decision errors and clean execution sealed it. Mega Gengar was registered but not brought to the decider, which was the right call given the matchup.
reflections.adjustment: The bring and prep were strong for this opponent. In a future series, keep Skeledirge as a mandatory bring against this Incineroar/Farigiraf/Sneasler core. Consider whether Klefki over Corviknight adds more value (Tailwind + screens support) since Corviknight saw limited impact. Mega Gengar remains a reasonable registration for games where trapping is needed, but Skeledirge's snowball is the more reliable win condition here. Greninja left behind could have been useful against Skarmory but wasn't necessary.
reflections.notebook: Opponent core tendency: Incineroar/Sneasler/Farigiraf/Skarmory bring, Gardevoir+Dedenne benched. Farigiraf is the Trick Room pivot — Taunt it every time it enters. Sneasler is FocusSash Unburden Jolly; expect it as lead or early pressure. Incineroar runs Fake Out/Parting Shot/Flare Blitz/WoW with Leftovers — burn Gyarados if possible but misses happen. Skarmory runs Occa Berry Sturdy — fire coverage is needed but Torch Song 2HKOs through Occa. Skeledirge Unaware LumBerry is the MVP: Torch Song snowball + resists Flare Blitz; always bring it. Gyarados Taunt is critical utility vs Farigiraf. Mamoswine FocusSash provides Ice Shard priority and speed tier control. Opponent struggles against SpA snowball + Taunt denial; lean into that pattern.

reflections.summary: The game and series were lost because Skeledirge was allowed to snowball with Torch Song, reaching +4 SpA and KOing Skarmory and Farigiraf. Trick Room never came up because Gyarados repeatedly Taunted Farigiraf, locking it out of setting. Our damage options were poor: Incineroar's Flare Blitz was resisted, and Farigiraf's Psychic was neutral. The between-game plan to preserve Farigiraf and double Skeledirge failed under Taunt pressure, and Incineroar, left as the last mon, couldn't out-damage the snowballing Skeledirge.
reflections.adjustment: Against this opponent, bring a stronger counter to Skeledirge, such as a Dark-type attacker (e.g., Sneasler's Throat Chop) or a Ghost-type move, and a Trick Room setter that can absorb Taunt (Mental Herb or a faster setter). Consider including Mega Gardevoir for its coverage or Alakazam for speed control. Also, prioritize preventing Gyarados from using Taunt—either by KOing it early, using a Taunt of our own, or switching to a Magic Bounce user. If bringing Incineroar, avoid relying on its resisted Flare Blitz; instead use Parting Shot to cycle and preserve offensive pressure.
reflections.notebook: Skeledirge is the primary threat: Unaware, Fire/Ghost, resists Flare Blitz, immune to burn, Ghost-immune to Normal/Hyper Voice. It boosts via Torch Song and must be doubled or removed before it snowballs. Gyarados carries Taunt to block Trick Room, has Intimidate, and holds Sitrus Berry. Corviknight has Mirror Armor—never Parting Shot or Wisp it. Mamoswine has Focus Sash and priority Ice Shard. The opponent often leads Gyarados+Skeledirge. For a rematch, bring a Taunt-proof Trick Room setter or a faster setter, and include a strong Dark/Ghost move to hit Skeledirge. Also, have a plan to neutralize Gyarados's Taunt, such as a Mental Herb or a Pokemon with Taunt of our own.
